module Test where

import Daml.Script

import Asset
import Shop

data Fixture = Fixture with
  issuer : Party
  producer : Party
  owner : Party
  vendor : Party
  user : Party
  shopId : ShopId
  itemId : ItemId
  iouId : IouId
  vendorId : VendorRelationshipId
  userId : UserRelationshipId

data Test a b = Test with
  given : Script a
  when : a -> Script b
  then_ : a -> b -> Script Bool

run : Test a b -> Script ()
run t = do
  fixture <- t.given
  result <- t.when fixture
  check <- t.then_ fixture result
  assert $ check

given_a_shop : Script Fixture
given_a_shop = do
  issuer <- allocateParty "Issuer"
  producer <- allocateParty "Producer"
  owner <- allocateParty "Owner"
  vendor <- allocateParty "Vendor"
  user <- allocateParty "User"

  itemId <- submit producer do createCmd Item with producer; owner = producer; label = "Apple"; quantity = 1.0; unit = "kg"; observers = []
  itemId <- submit producer do exerciseCmd itemId TransferItem with newOwner = vendor
  iouId <- submit issuer do createCmd Iou with issuer; owner = issuer; amount = 3.0; currency = "USD"
  iouId <- submit issuer do exerciseCmd iouId TransferIou with newOwner = user

  shopId <- submit owner do createCmd Shop with owner; vendors = []; users = []; offerIds = []
  (shopId, inviteId) <- submit owner do exerciseCmd shopId InviteVendor with vendor
  vendorId <- submit vendor do exerciseCmd inviteId AcceptVendorInvite
  (shopId, inviteId) <- submit owner do exerciseCmd shopId InviteUser with user
  userId <- submit user do exerciseCmd inviteId AcceptUserInvite
  pure Fixture with ..

when_the_vendor_offers_an_item : Fixture -> Script (ShopId, OfferId)
when_the_vendor_offers_an_item f = do
  submit f.vendor do exerciseCmd f.vendorId OfferItem with shopId = f.shopId; itemId = f.itemId; price = 1.0; currency = "USD"

then_the_offer_is_added_to_the_shop : Fixture -> (ShopId, OfferId) -> Script Bool
then_the_offer_is_added_to_the_shop f (shopId, offerId) = do
  Some shop <- queryContractId f.owner shopId
  pure $ offerId `elem` shop.offerIds

then_the_offer_is_visible_to_the_user : Fixture -> (ShopId, OfferId) -> Script Bool
then_the_offer_is_visible_to_the_user f (shopId, offerId) = do
  Some _ <- queryContractId f.user offerId
  pure True

when_an_item_is_bought : Fixture -> Script (ShopId, ItemId, IouId)
when_an_item_is_bought f = do
  let Fixture{..} = f
  (shopId, offerId) <- submit vendor do exerciseCmd vendorId OfferItem with price = 3.0; currency = "USD"; ..
  submit user do exerciseCmd userId BuyItem with ..

then_the_item_and_iou_exchange_hands : Fixture -> (ShopId, ItemId, IouId) -> Script Bool
then_the_item_and_iou_exchange_hands f (shopId, itemId, iouId) = do
  Some item <- queryContractId f.user itemId
  Some iou <- queryContractId f.vendor iouId
  pure $ item.owner == f.user && iou.owner == f.vendor

gwt = script do
  let offer_added = Test with
        given = given_a_shop
        when = when_the_vendor_offers_an_item
        then_ = then_the_offer_is_added_to_the_shop
  let offer_user_visible = offer_added with
        then_ = then_the_offer_is_visible_to_the_user
  let asset_exchange = Test with
        given = given_a_shop
        when = when_an_item_is_bought
        then_ = then_the_item_and_iou_exchange_hands
  run offer_added
  run offer_user_visible
  run asset_exchange

module Test where

import Daml.Script
import Asset
import Shop

data Actors = Actors with
  issuer : Party
  producer : Party
  owner : Party
  vendor : Party
  user : Party
  stranger : Party

actors : Script Actors
actors = do
  issuer <- allocateParty "Issuer"
  producer <- allocateParty "Producer"
  owner <- allocateParty "ShopOwner"
  vendor <- allocateParty "Vendor"
  user <- allocateParty "User"
  stranger <- allocateParty "Stranger"
  pure Actors with ..

openShop : Actors -> Script ShopId
openShop Actors{..} =
  submit owner do createCmd Shop with owner; vendors = []; users = []; offerIds = []

addVendor : Actors -> ShopId -> Script (ShopId, VendorRelationshipId)
addVendor Actors{..} shopId = do
  (nextShop, inviteId) <- submit owner do exerciseCmd shopId InviteVendor with vendor
  relationshipId <- submit vendor do exerciseCmd inviteId AcceptVendorInvite
  pure (nextShop, relationshipId)

addUser : Actors -> ShopId -> Script (ShopId, UserRelationshipId)
addUser Actors{..} shopId = do
  (nextShop, inviteId) <- submit owner do exerciseCmd shopId InviteUser with user
  relationshipId <- submit user do exerciseCmd inviteId AcceptUserInvite
  pure (nextShop, relationshipId)

newItem : Actors -> Script ItemId
newItem Actors{..} =
  submit producer do createCmd Item with producer; owner = vendor; label = "Tea"; quantity = 3.0; unit = "box"; observers = [vendor]

newIou : Actors -> Decimal -> Text -> Script IouId
newIou Actors{..} amount currency =
  submit issuer do createCmd Iou with issuer; owner = user; amount; currency

testOnboarding : Script ()
testOnboarding = do
  parties@Actors{..} <- actors
  initialShop <- openShop parties
  submitMustFail stranger do exerciseCmd initialShop InviteVendor with vendor
  (vendorShop, vendorInvite) <- submit owner do exerciseCmd initialShop InviteVendor with vendor
  submitMustFail stranger do exerciseCmd vendorInvite AcceptVendorInvite
  vendorRelationship <- submit vendor do exerciseCmd vendorInvite AcceptVendorInvite
  Some relationship <- queryContractId vendor vendorRelationship
  assert (relationship.owner == owner && relationship.vendor == vendor)
  Some vendorShopContract <- queryContractId owner vendorShop
  assert (vendorShopContract.vendors == [vendor] && vendorShopContract.users == [])
  submitMustFail stranger do exerciseCmd vendorShop InviteUser with user
  (userShop, userInvite) <- submit owner do exerciseCmd vendorShop InviteUser with user
  submitMustFail stranger do exerciseCmd userInvite AcceptUserInvite
  userRelationship <- submit user do exerciseCmd userInvite AcceptUserInvite
  Some userRelation <- queryContractId user userRelationship
  assert (userRelation.owner == owner && userRelation.user == user)
  Some userShopContract <- queryContractId owner userShop
  assert (userShopContract.vendors == [vendor] && userShopContract.users == [user])

testAssetChoices : Script ()
testAssetChoices = do
  Actors{..} <- actors
  itemId <- submit producer do createCmd Item with producer = producer; owner = producer; label = "Tea"; quantity = 3.0; unit = "box"; observers = [vendor]
  submitMustFail stranger do exerciseCmd itemId TransferItem with newOwner = vendor
  transferred <- submit producer do exerciseCmd itemId TransferItem with newOwner = vendor
  Some item <- queryContractId producer transferred
  assert (item.owner == vendor && item.producer == producer && item.label == "Tea")
  assert (item.quantity == 3.0 && item.unit == "box" && item.observers == [vendor])
  submitMustFail producer do exerciseCmd itemId TransferItem with newOwner = user
  submitMustFail stranger do exerciseCmd transferred Disclose with users = [user]
  disclosed <- submit vendor do exerciseCmd transferred Disclose with users = [owner, user]
  Some disclosedItem <- queryContractId producer disclosed
  assert (disclosedItem.owner == vendor && disclosedItem.observers == [owner, user])
  iouId <- submit issuer do createCmd Iou with issuer; owner = issuer; amount = 12.0; currency = "USD"
  submitMustFail stranger do exerciseCmd iouId TransferIou with newOwner = user
  transferredIou <- submit issuer do exerciseCmd iouId TransferIou with newOwner = user
  Some iou <- queryContractId issuer transferredIou
  assert (iou.owner == user && iou.issuer == issuer && iou.amount == 12.0 && iou.currency == "USD")
  submitMustFail issuer do exerciseCmd iouId TransferIou with newOwner = stranger

testTrade : Script ()
testTrade = do
  parties@Actors{..} <- actors
  initialShop <- openShop parties
  (vendorShop, vendorRelationship) <- addVendor parties initialShop
  (readyShop, userRelationship) <- addUser parties vendorShop
  itemId <- newItem parties
  submitMustFail stranger do exerciseCmd vendorRelationship OfferItem with shopId = readyShop; itemId; price = 12.0; currency = "USD"
  (offeredShop, offerId) <- submit vendor do exerciseCmd vendorRelationship OfferItem with shopId = readyShop; itemId; price = 12.0; currency = "USD"
  Some shop <- queryContractId owner offeredShop
  assert (shop.offerIds == [offerId] && shop.users == [user] && shop.vendors == [vendor])
  Some offer <- queryContractId owner offerId
  assert (offer.owner == owner && offer.vendor == vendor && offer.price == 12.0)
  assert (offer.currency == "USD" && offer.users == [user])
  Some disclosedItem <- queryContractId producer offer.itemId
  assert (disclosedItem.owner == vendor && disclosedItem.observers == [owner, user])
  iouId <- newIou parties 12.0 "USD"
  submitMustFail stranger do exerciseCmd userRelationship BuyItem with shopId = offeredShop; offerId; iouId
  (soldShop, boughtItemId, paidIouId) <- submit user do exerciseCmd userRelationship BuyItem with shopId = offeredShop; offerId; iouId
  Some soldShopContract <- queryContractId owner soldShop
  assert (soldShopContract.offerIds == [] && soldShopContract.users == [user])
  Some boughtItem <- queryContractId producer boughtItemId
  assert (boughtItem.owner == user && boughtItem.producer == producer)
  assert (boughtItem.label == "Tea" && boughtItem.quantity == 3.0 && boughtItem.unit == "box")
  Some paidIou <- queryContractId issuer paidIouId
  assert (paidIou.owner == vendor && paidIou.issuer == issuer)
  assert (paidIou.amount == 12.0 && paidIou.currency == "USD")
  submitMustFail user do exerciseCmd userRelationship BuyItem with shopId = soldShop; offerId; iouId

testInvalidPurchases : Script ()
testInvalidPurchases = do
  parties@Actors{..} <- actors
  initialShop <- openShop parties
  (vendorShop, vendorRelationship) <- addVendor parties initialShop
  (readyShop, userRelationship) <- addUser parties vendorShop
  itemId <- newItem parties
  (offeredShop, offerId) <- submit vendor do exerciseCmd vendorRelationship OfferItem with shopId = readyShop; itemId; price = 12.0; currency = "USD"
  wrongAmount <- newIou parties 11.0 "USD"
  submitMustFail user do exerciseCmd userRelationship BuyItem with shopId = offeredShop; offerId; iouId = wrongAmount
  wrongCurrency <- newIou parties 12.0 "EUR"
  submitMustFail user do exerciseCmd userRelationship BuyItem with shopId = offeredShop; offerId; iouId = wrongCurrency
  correctIou <- newIou parties 12.0 "USD"
  submitMustFail user do exerciseCmd userRelationship BuyItem with shopId = readyShop; offerId; iouId = correctIou
  Some stillOffered <- queryContractId owner offeredShop
  assert (stillOffered.offerIds == [offerId])
  Some currentOffer <- queryContractId owner offerId
  Some stillItem <- queryContractId producer currentOffer.itemId
  assert (stillItem.owner == vendor)
  (soldShop, _, _) <- submit user do exerciseCmd userRelationship BuyItem with shopId = offeredShop; offerId; iouId = correctIou
  Some finalShop <- queryContractId owner soldShop
  assert (finalShop.offerIds == [])

testMultipleOffers : Script ()
testMultipleOffers = do
  parties@Actors{..} <- actors
  initialShop <- openShop parties
  (vendorShop, vendorRelationship) <- addVendor parties initialShop
  (readyShop, userRelationship) <- addUser parties vendorShop
  firstItem <- newItem parties
  (oneOfferShop, firstOffer) <- submit vendor do exerciseCmd vendorRelationship OfferItem with shopId = readyShop; itemId = firstItem; price = 12.0; currency = "USD"
  secondItem <- newItem parties
  (twoOfferShop, secondOffer) <- submit vendor do exerciseCmd vendorRelationship OfferItem with shopId = oneOfferShop; itemId = secondItem; price = 20.0; currency = "EUR"
  Some twoOffers <- queryContractId owner twoOfferShop
  assert (twoOffers.offerIds == [secondOffer, firstOffer])
  firstPayment <- newIou parties 12.0 "USD"
  (oneRemainingShop, firstPurchased, firstPaid) <- submit user do exerciseCmd userRelationship BuyItem with shopId = twoOfferShop; offerId = firstOffer; iouId = firstPayment
  Some oneRemaining <- queryContractId owner oneRemainingShop
  assert (oneRemaining.offerIds == [secondOffer])
  Some firstPurchasedItem <- queryContractId producer firstPurchased
  Some firstPaidIou <- queryContractId issuer firstPaid
  assert (firstPurchasedItem.owner == user && firstPaidIou.owner == vendor)
  secondPayment <- newIou parties 20.0 "EUR"
  (emptyShop, secondPurchased, secondPaid) <- submit user do exerciseCmd userRelationship BuyItem with shopId = oneRemainingShop; offerId = secondOffer; iouId = secondPayment
  Some empty <- queryContractId owner emptyShop
  assert (empty.offerIds == [] && empty.vendors == [vendor] && empty.users == [user])
  Some secondPurchasedItem <- queryContractId producer secondPurchased
  Some secondPaidIou <- queryContractId issuer secondPaid
  assert (secondPurchasedItem.owner == user && secondPaidIou.owner == vendor)
  assert (secondPaidIou.amount == 20.0 && secondPaidIou.currency == "EUR")

testInvalidOffers : Script ()
testInvalidOffers = do
  parties@Actors{..} <- actors
  initialShop <- openShop parties
  (vendorShop, relationship) <- addVendor parties initialShop
  (readyShop, _) <- addUser parties vendorShop
  otherItem <- submit producer do createCmd Item with producer; owner = producer; label = "Not for sale"; quantity = 1.0; unit = "each"; observers = [vendor]
  submitMustFail vendor do exerciseCmd relationship OfferItem with shopId = readyShop; itemId = otherItem; price = 5.0; currency = "USD"
  Some unsold <- queryContractId producer otherItem
  assert (unsold.owner == producer)
  Some unchangedShop <- queryContractId owner readyShop
  assert (unchangedShop.offerIds == [])
  ownedItem <- newItem parties
  (offeredShop, offerId) <- submit vendor do exerciseCmd relationship OfferItem with shopId = readyShop; itemId = ownedItem; price = 5.0; currency = "USD"
  submitMustFail vendor do exerciseCmd offerId Settle with buyer = user
  Some validOffer <- queryContractId owner offerId
  assert (validOffer.price == 5.0 && validOffer.currency == "USD")
  Some updatedShop <- queryContractId owner offeredShop
  assert (updatedShop.offerIds == [offerId])
